checktimeout.description: How long (in seconds) to wait before declaring a real server as failed.

checkinterval.description: How often (in seconds) to perform health checks on real servers.

logfile.description: Path to the log file for ldirectord messages.

emailalert.description: Enable email notifications for status changes (true/false).

emailalertfreq.description: How often (in seconds) to re-send alert emails (0 = only on state change).

emailalertsubject.description: Subject line for alert emails. May include {{service}} and {{state}} placeholders.

emailalertto.description: List of recipient email addresses for alerts.

quiesce.description: If true, quiesce (drain) failed servers instead of removing them immediately (true/false).

scheduler.description: Default load balancing scheduler for all services (e.g., 'wrr' for weighted round robin).

persistence.description: Default persistence timeout in seconds (0 = no persistence).

persistence_timeout.description: Alias for 'persistence' — timeout in seconds for session persistence.

netmask.description: Network mask for direct routing (e.g., '255.255.255.255' for DR, '255.255.255.0' for NAT).

gateway.description: Gateway IP for NAT mode (leave empty if using direct routing).

services.description: List of LVS virtual services to monitor.

vip.description: Virtual IP address of this service.

port.description: Port number for the virtual service.

group.description: Optional service group name (for managing related services together).

protocol.description: Override global protocol (tcp/udp). Leave empty to inherit.

scheduler.description: Override global scheduler for this service. Leave empty to inherit.

quiesce.description: Override global quiesce setting for this service. Leave null to inherit.

persistence.description: Override global persistence timeout (seconds) for this service. Leave null to inherit.

netmask.description: Override global netmask for this service. Leave null to inherit.

checktype.description: Health check method (http, tcp, connect, smtp, mysql, pgsql).

checkpath.description: HTTP request path (used only for HTTP checks).

domain.description: Virtual host header for HTTP checks.

receive.description: Expected string in HTTP response body or SMTP banner.

send.description: String to send in HTTP request body or SMTP command.

statuscode.description: Expected HTTP status code (for HTTP checks).

smtpmailfrom.description: Sender email for SMTP health checks.

smtphelo.description: HELO hostname for SMTP health checks.

pgsqldatabase.description: PostgreSQL database name for health checks.

reals.description: Real servers backing this virtual service.

port.description: Port to check on real server.

family.description: Address family (inet for IPv4, inet6 for IPv6).

backup.description: Mark as backup server (only used when active servers fail).
